reading.body:
Apify is a web scraping and automation platform founded in 2015 and based in Prague, offering thousands of pre-built scrapers and crawlers through a marketplace model, with EU hosting and GDPR compliance.

The platform's value lies in its ability to extract structured data from websites at scale, which is foundational to training data pipelines. AI models require vast quantities of internet-sourced text, images, and structured information, and web scraping tools like Apify reduce the friction and cost of that collection. The marketplace model, where users can share and monetize scrapers, creates an ecosystem of reusable extraction logic rather than forcing each AI team to build crawlers from scratch.

This data does not reveal how much compute Apify consumes, how its infrastructure scales with demand, or whether it serves AI training pipelines specifically versus other enterprise use cases. The EU hosting and GDPR compliance are noted but the data does not explain the infrastructure implications, power usage, or whether these regulatory choices constrain the speed or scale at which data can be extracted and moved to training clusters.

profile_text.body:
Apify describes itself as a marketplace of ready-to-run tools for AI, offering thousands of tools to automate business tasks such as getting real-time web data, tracking competitors, generating leads, and integrating apps and AI agents. Its site says the platform can crawl websites and extract text content to feed AI models, LLM applications, vector databases, or RAG pipelines, with an Actor that supports Markdown formatting, cleans HTML, downloads files, and integrates with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and the wider LLM ecosystem. The site also lists tools for extracting posts, videos, and engagement metrics from Facebook pages, including text captions, reactions, video transcripts, images, external links, and collaborators, with options to export ad data, schedule runs via API, and integrate with AI workflows. Apify states it works with Python and JavaScript, as well as Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Scrapy, and Crawlee, its own web crawling and browser automation library.

Apify is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Prague, Czech Republic. Its product is categorized as a web scraping platform with an actor marketplace and automation, and it is described as EU-hosted and GDPR-oriented. The company offers an MCP server named com.apify/apify-mcp-server, which is described as extracting data from any website with thousands of scrapers, crawlers, and automations on Apify Store. The site includes a statement that a collaboration with Apify proves advanced IT tools leveraging AI can be key in detecting infringements of consumer protection legislation.
